scenes.title_cn: 开场：R6 V 改变了什么
scenes.title_en: Opening: What the R6 V Changed
scenes.context: UP主带着佳能R6 V去了挪威霞穆尼，用了一个多月。这期不聊太多规格（传感器跟R6M3一样），分享它到底改变了哪些创作方式、哪些地方让人离不开它、哪些地方希望下一代改进。语域：评测口播，预告提纲。
sentences: 这台相机的传感器跟R6M3是一样的，所以这期视频我不会聊太多的规格。
This camera's sensor is the same as the R6 Mark III's, so I won't talk specs much in this video.
the same sensor（相同传感器）；talk specs（聊规格）
我想要跟大家分享它到底改变了我的哪些创作方式。
I want to share exactly how it has changed my creative workflow.
creative workflow（创作方式）；exactly how（到底怎样）
哪一些地方让我离不开它，又有哪一些地方我还希望佳能的下一代可以继续改进。
What makes it indispensable to me, and what I hope Canon will improve in the next generation.
indispensable（离不开）；the next generation（下一代）
paraphrase: 不聊规格 → won't talk specs / skip the spec sheet
talk specs · skip the spec sheet
离不开它 → indispensable / can't live without it
indispensable · can't live without it
scenes.speak: This camera's sensor is the same as the R6 Mark III's, so I won't talk specs much in this video. I want to share exactly how it has changed my creative workflow. What makes it indispensable to me, and what I hope Canon will improve in the next generation.

scenes.title_en: Why I Bought It: Compactness and High ISO
scenes.context: 购买动机有两个：一是紧凑设计——没有取景器，可以架着快装版直接收进包里，空间占用非常小。二是两档ISO——直出第二档ISO在3200，C-Log2第二档在6400，室内很多场景以前需要减光镜，现在直接把ISO推到6400就能拍。语域：评测口播，实物演示。
sentences: 它没有取景器，我就可以下面再架着快装版收进去，它占的空间非常非常的小。
It has no viewfinder, so I can slide it into the bag on a quick-release plate — it takes up so little space.
a quick-release plate（快装版）；takes up so little space（占空间很小）
C-Log2的第二档ISO在6400，室内很多场景我直接把ISO推到6400就可以继续拍了。
C-Log2's second-base ISO is 6400 — for many indoor scenes I just push ISO to 6400 and keep shooting.
second-base ISO（第二档ISO）；push ISO to 6400（把ISO推到6400）
以前我会需要裁减光镜，而现在我都不需要了，提高了很多室内外场景转换的拍摄效率。
I used to need ND filters; now I don't — it boosted my indoor-outdoor shooting efficiency a lot.
ND filters（减光镜）；shooting efficiency（拍摄效率）
paraphrase: 占空间小 → takes up little space / packs down small
little space · packs down small
拍摄效率 → shooting efficiency / quicker scene changes
shooting efficiency · quicker changes
scenes.speak: It has no viewfinder, so I can slide it into the bag on a quick-release plate — it takes up so little space. C-Log2's second-base ISO is 6400 — for many indoor scenes I just push ISO to 6400 and keep shooting. I used to need ND filters; now I don't — it boosted my indoor-outdoor shooting efficiency a lot.

scenes.context: 原本最担心续航，带了很多电池，结果完全白担心。拍摄鸟类时相机大多数情况待机，随时拍摄。从早上9点到下午4点拍将近2TB素材只用了5颗电池，跟R5M2续航状况差不多，还省下了电池添购费用。语域：评测口播，实测数据。
sentences: 我原本最担心的就是续航，所以这次我带了很多的电池，结果是完全白担心。
Battery life was my biggest worry, so I packed tons of batteries — turns out it was completely unnecessary.
completely unnecessary（完全白担心）；pack tons of batteries（带很多电池）
从早上9点到下午4点，拍摄的素材量将近2TB，总共只使用了5颗电池。
From 9 a.m. to 4 p.m., I shot nearly 2TB of footage using just five batteries.
footage（素材）；just five batteries（只用了5颗电池）
也因此我省下了不少的电池添购费用。
Which also saved me from buying a lot of extra batteries.
save from buying（省下添购费用）
paraphrase: 白担心 → worry for nothing / unnecessary worry
worry for nothing · unnecessary worry
待机随时拍 → standby-ready / always on, ready to shoot
standby-ready · always on
scenes.speak: Battery life was my biggest worry, so I packed tons of batteries — turns out it was completely unnecessary. From 9 a.m. to 4 p.m., I shot nearly 2TB of footage using just five batteries. Which also saved me from buying a lot of extra batteries.

scenes.title_en: Tromsø: Light Breaking Through the Clouds
scenes.context: 拍鸟之后回到挪威特罗姆瑟。那天是下雨天，但坐上观光缆车后光从云中间照出来射在岛上，超级漂亮。原本想着只观光带手机就好，结果当天太阳突然穿过云层，整个特罗姆瑟被光打亮，非常庆幸当时带的是R6V。语域：评测口播，场景叙述。
sentences: 特罗姆瑟有一个观光缆车，你可以上到山顶去俯瞰整个城市。
Tromsø has a sightseeing cable car that takes you to the top to overlook the city.
a sightseeing cable car（观光缆车）；overlook the city（俯瞰城市）
那天是个下雨天，但是当我上到缆车上面之后，光从云中间照出来，射在岛上面，超级的漂亮。
It was a rainy day, but once I got up on the cable car, light broke through the clouds and hit the island — absolutely stunning.
light broke through the clouds（光穿透云层）；absolutely stunning（超级漂亮）
太阳突然穿过云层，整个特罗姆瑟被光打亮，我真的蛮庆幸我当时带的是R6V。
The sun suddenly cut through the clouds and lit up all of Tromsø — I'm so glad I had the R6V with me.
lit up all of Tromsø（照亮整个特罗姆瑟）；so glad（很庆幸）
paraphrase: 光穿云层 → light broke through the clouds / sun cut through
break through · cut through
被光打亮 → lit up / bathed in light
lit up · bathed in light
scenes.speak: Tromsø has a sightseeing cable car that takes you to the top to overlook the city. It was a rainy day, but once I got up on the cable car, light broke through the clouds and hit the island — absolutely stunning. The sun suddenly cut through the clouds and lit up all of Tromsø — I'm so glad I had the R6V with me.

scenes.context: 在缆车上根本不用去思考拍横的还是竖的，直接Open Gate拍摄，甚至有7K RAW 60fps。确实很吃存储，UP主用竖拍宽银幕的方式拍了接近1:1的素材格式，参考另一位博主李宇辰的视频。语域：评测口播，格式讲解。
sentences: 那时候我根本不用太去思考我到底要拍横的还是竖的，我就直接Open Gate。
I didn't have to think about horizontal or vertical — I just shot in Open Gate.
Open Gate（全画幅全高模式）；horizontal or vertical（横或竖）
甚至我有7K RAW 60fps，我拍就对了。
I even have 7K RAW at 60fps — I just kept shooting.
7K RAW at 60fps（7K RAW 60帧）
确实这样拍会吃掉非常多的存储，所以我用了竖拍宽银幕的方式拍了一个接近1比1的素材格式。
It does eat up a ton of storage, so I used the vertical-wide technique to shoot a near-1:1 format.
eat up storage（吃存储）；a near-1:1 format（接近1:1的格式）
paraphrase: 拍就对了 → just keep shooting / don't overthink it
keep shooting · don't overthink
吃存储 → eat up storage / storage-hungry
eat up storage · storage-hungry
scenes.speak: I didn't have to think about horizontal or vertical — I just shot in Open Gate. I even have 7K RAW at 60fps — I just kept shooting. It does eat up a ton of storage, so I used the vertical-wide technique to shoot a near-1:1 format.

scenes.title_en: Rain, Wind, and Heat: Doubts Put to Rest
scenes.context: 山上雨大风大，很多人担心风扇设计下雨怎么办。R6V的风扇设计在机身侧边，风往外排，一般下雨环境进水风险没那么高。过热方面，室内连续拍5分钟Open Gate RAW视频没有任何过热提醒，大家可以完全把疑虑拿掉。语域：评测口播，实测说明。
sentences: 很多人会像我一样很担心，它的风扇设计下雨怎么办。
Many people would worry like I did — what about the fan design in the rain?
the fan design（风扇设计）；in the rain（下雨时）
R6V的风扇设计在机身的侧边，而且风是往外排的，一般下雨的环境进水风险没那么高。
The R6V's fan is on the side of the body and blows outward, so rain-seepage risk is lower than you'd think.
blows outward（往外排）；seepage risk（进水风险）
我在室内连续拍摄5分钟Open Gate RAW的视频，都没有任何过热的提醒。
I shot five straight minutes of Open Gate RAW indoors with zero overheating warnings.
overheating warnings（过热提醒）；five straight minutes（连续5分钟）
paraphrase: 进水风险 → rain-seepage risk / water ingress risk
seepage risk · water ingress
疑虑消除 → doubts put to rest / worries gone
put to rest · worries gone
scenes.speak: Many people would worry like I did — what about the fan design in the rain? The R6V's fan is on the side of the body and blows outward, so rain-seepage risk is lower than you'd think. I shot five straight minutes of Open Gate RAW indoors with zero overheating warnings.

scenes.context: 在特罗姆瑟报名了一艘有109年历史的木造渔船的出海行程，天气非常好，只带了R6V。UP主在船上疯狂寻找光影、美丽的视角，享受寻找电影感故事感的创作过程。全程几乎都用Open Gate RAW拍摄，存储量大但换来最高画质和最多细节。语域：评测口播，情感叙述。
sentences: 搭的是一艘已经有109年历史的木造渔船，那时候他们跟我分享了关于这艘船的故事，让我想起一部电影叫做《战马》。
The boat was a 109-year-old wooden fishing vessel — and hearing its story reminded me of the film War Horse.
a wooden fishing vessel（木造渔船）；remind me of（让我想起）
我非常享受我拿着这台相机疯狂寻找光影、美丽角度的创作过程。
I thoroughly enjoyed hunting for light and beautiful angles with this camera.
hunting for light（寻找光影）；beautiful angles（美丽角度）
再强调一次存储量确实很大，但这个格式让我拥有最高的画质、最多的细节，我拍就对了。
Again, storage is huge — but this format gives me the best quality and most detail, so I just keep shooting.
the best quality and most detail（最高画质最多细节）
paraphrase: 疯狂寻找光影 → hunting for light / chasing light and shadow
hunting for light · chasing light
电影感故事感 → cinematic, story-driven / filmic and narrative
cinematic · filmic and narrative
scenes.speak: The boat was a 109-year-old wooden fishing vessel — and hearing its story reminded me of the film War Horse. I thoroughly enjoyed hunting for light and beautiful angles with this camera. Again, storage is huge — but this format gives me the best quality and most detail, so I just keep shooting.

scenes.title_en: Three Flaws, and What Makes a Successful Camera
scenes.context: 如果要挑缺点：快门帘希望能回来，换镜头更安心（但1399的价格没什么好抱怨的）；速控菜单不能直接调Open Gate，需要跳进菜单关设置，效率低一点；开机键在机身侧边容易误触，前面录制键端着Vlog时容易碰到。最后总结：R6V不只是一台性能怪兽，还是一台愿意让你一直待在身边的相机。创作最重要的是画面出现时相机就在手上。语域：评测口播，辩证收尾。
sentences: 第一个缺点就是快门帘，我真的很希望它那个快门帘能够回来，让我换镜头的时候就不用担心太多。
The first flaw is the shutter curtain — I really wish it would come back, so I wouldn't worry when swapping lenses.
the shutter curtain（快门帘）；swap lenses（换镜头）
开机键设计在手柄的侧边，放进背包里就可能会一推就开机，误触概率还蛮高的。
The power button sits on the grip's side, so sliding it into a backpack can power it on — accidental triggers are common.
accidental triggers（误触）；power it on（开机）
如果一台相机让你更愿意去记录、更愿意去创作，那它对我来说就是一台成功的相机。
If a camera makes you more willing to record and create, then to me, it's a successful camera.
more willing to create（更愿意创作）；a successful camera（成功的相机）
paraphrase: 误触 → accidental triggers / bump it on by accident
accidental triggers · bump it on
性能怪兽 → a performance beast / an absolute powerhouse
performance beast · powerhouse
scenes.speak: The first flaw is the shutter curtain — I really wish it would come back, so I wouldn't worry when swapping lenses. The power button sits on the grip's side, so sliding it into a backpack can power it on — accidental triggers are common. If a camera makes you more willing to record and create, then to me, it's a successful camera.

practice: It has no viewfinder, so it packs down really small in the bag.
I packed tons of batteries — turns out the worry was completely unnecessary.
The fan blows outward from the side, so rain-seepage risk is lower than you'd think.
If a camera makes you want to create, it's a successful camera.
pitfalls: The sensor is same as R6M3.
The sensor is the same as the R6 Mark III's.
same 前需要 the，且 the same as 是固定搭配。
Battery life was my biggest worry.
very worry 中式；用 my biggest worry 或 I was really worried。
The format eats up a ton of storage.
take much storage 生硬；用 eat up storage（吃存储）更地道。
I don't need think horizontal or vertical.
I don't need to think about horizontal or vertical.
need 后接 to do；think about（考虑）不能漏介词 about。
shifts: 用 packs down small（收得小）、takes up little space（占空间小）、compact rig（紧凑装备）
用 five batteries for 2TB（5颗电池拍2TB）、worry-free battery（无续航焦虑）
说相机有意义只会 good camera
用 makes you want to create（让你想创作）、a successful camera（成功的相机）
footer_notes: ASR 专有名词已校正：USR 6V/R6V→R6 V、R6M3→R6 Mark III、Z50→Z50（尼康）、Kenneth 120→Canon EOS、R5M2→R5 Mark II、视流→RF系列、E53E房→EF镜头、C50→C70？、霞穆尼→霞慕尼、特羅姆社/特羅姆瑟→特羅姆瑟、Open Gate→Open Gate、Clog2→C-Log2、李宇辰→李宇辰、家族→老师、战马→《战马》、母造渔船→木造渔船、1399→价格（$1399）、兔籠→兔笼、变形塊螢幕→变形宽银幕、速控菜單→速控菜单等。
